name: Missouri University of Science and Technology

scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class, C1): 8,330 applied, 6,550 admitted (78.6%), 1,251 enrolled. Residency rows: in-state 2,966 / out-of-state 3,373 / international 1,986 applicants, plus 5 applicants (1 admitted) with unknown residency, which add up to the totals. International first-years: 1,986 applied, 1,119 admitted (56.3%), 27 enrolled. No early decision, no early action and no waitlist (C2, C21, C22); rolling admission. GPA breakdown covers all enrolled students who reported a GPA (97.8%); the 4.0 row is the share with a 4.0 GPA. Only 11.7% of the enrolled class (147 students) submitted SAT scores versus 68.2% (853) ACT, so the SAT percentiles rest on a small group. Undergraduate enrollment (5,687) and the nonresident count (211) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures in B1/B2.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for the 2025-2026 academic year from the Common Data Set (G1; the 'not available' box is not ticked): Missouri-resident tuition $14,328, nonresident tuition $33,516 (12-18 credits per term at one rate), required fees $1,636, food and housing on campus $13,422. Estimated expenses (G5, residents): books $720, transportation $1,774, other $1,172 (other costs shown = transportation + other). IMPORTANT: tuition varies by degree program (CDS G3/G4: 68% of undergraduates pay more than the G1 figure); the G1 figure matches the lowest rate group (Rate 1: e.g. economics, psychology, English, history). The university's Fall 2026 & Spring 2027 undergraduate fee schedule (opened 2026-11-03) lists nonresident per-semester plateau rates for 12-18 hours of $17,422 (Rate 1), $18,570 (Rate 2: sciences, mathematics, business, information science) and $19,718 (Rate 3: all engineering degrees, computer science, semiconductor engineering, undeclared), plus an activity and facility fee of $42 per credit hour (caps at 12 hours) and a health service fee of $223.59 per semester. International students also pay a $150 international student service fee each semester and are auto-enrolled in mandatory health insurance billed per term. No total is entered because the 2026-27 rates differ from these CDS figures.
